(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.1: CRYOGENIC BATH LEVEL 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A: Capacitive Probe | Channel B: Hydrostatic DP | Channel C: Multi-Point Thermal Rake
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Calculate Cross-Channel Absolute Discrepancies *)
rLevelDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
rLevelDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorB_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
rLevelDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorC_mm - rBathLevel_SensorA_mm);

(* Individual Sensor Health and Plausibility Assessment *)
IF (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelA_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelB_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rBathLevel_SensorC_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorC_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Drift and Discrepancy Fault Discrimination *)
IF bLevelA_Healthy AND bLevelB_Healthy AND (rLevelDiscrepancy_AB > rLevelTolerance_mm) THEN
    IF rLevelDiscrepancy_CA > rLevelTolerance_mm THEN
        (* Channel A deviates from both B and C -> Shed Channel A *)
        bLevelA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rLevelDiscrepancy_BC > rLevelTolerance_mm THEN
        (* Channel B deviates from both A and C -> Shed Channel B *)
        bLevelB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bLevelB_Healthy AND bLevelC_Healthy AND (rLevelDiscrepancy_BC > rLevelTolerance_mm) THEN
    IF (rLevelDiscrepancy_CA > rLevelTolerance_mm) AND bLevelA_Healthy THEN
        (* Channel C deviates from both A and B -> Shed Channel C *)
        bLevelC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Recompute Healthy Sensor Tally *)
iLevelHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLevelA_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLevelB_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLevelC_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting / Degraded 1oo2 Averaging / Fail-Safe Selection *)
IF iLevelHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Select Logic *)
    IF ((rBathLevel_SensorA_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorB_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) OR
       ((rBathLevel_SensorA_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorB_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorA_mm;
    ELSIF ((rBathLevel_SensorB_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorA_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) OR
          ((rBathLevel_SensorB_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorA_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorB_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorC_mm;
    END_IF;
    tLevelDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#2S);
ELSIF iLevelHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Operational Mode: Average the two healthy channels *)
    IF bLevelA_Healthy AND bLevelB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm + rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
    ELSIF bLevelB_Healthy AND bLevelC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm + rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorB_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm + rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
    END_IF;
    
    (* Raise Maintenance Warning Word Bit 4: Cryo Level Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000010;

    (* Check if remaining two sensors diverge beyond tolerance *)
    tLevelDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > rLevelTolerance_mm), PT := T#2S);
    IF tLevelDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        (* Divergence in 1oo2 mode causes immediate shutdown trip *)
        dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000004; (* Cryo Level 2oo3 Total Failure *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLevelHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Severe Degradation: Single Sensor Operating - Raise Warning Bit 5 *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000020;
    IF bLevelA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorA_mm;
    ELSIF bLevelB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorB_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorC_mm;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Loss (0 Healthy) -> Immediate Emergency Stop Trip *)
    rVotedLevel_mm := 0.0;
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000004; (* Cryo Level Total Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.2: CRYOGENIC BATH TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A, B, C: Triplicated Ultra-Stable Class-A RTD Pt100 Cryogenic Sensors
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

rTempDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
rTempDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
rTempDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K);

(* Plausibility Checks: Sub-cooled Nitrogen Bath [65.0 K .. 120.0 K] *)
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K > 120.0) THEN
    bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K > 120.0) THEN

END_IF;
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K > 120.0) THEN
    bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Identify Outlier Channel *)
IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_AB > rTempTolerance_K) THEN
    IF rTempDiscrepancy_CA > rTempTolerance_K THEN
        bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_K THEN
        bTempB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;

IF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_K) THEN

        bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;

(* Recompute Healthy RTD Count *)
iTempHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTempA_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempB_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempC_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Voted Temperature Synthesis *)
IF iTempHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* 2oo3 Median Select *)
    IF ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) OR
       ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K;
    ELSIF ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) OR
          ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K;
    END_IF;
    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#2S);
ELSIF iTempHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
    ELSIF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000040; (* Warning Bit 6: Cryo Temp Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)

    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > rTempTolerance_K), PT := T#2S);
    IF tTempDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000008; (* Cryo Temp 2oo3 Total Failure Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTempHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000080; (* Warning Bit 7: Cryo Temp Single Sensor Remaining *)
    IF bTempA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K;
    ELSIF bTempB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_K := 300.0; (* Failsafe high temperature default *)
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000008; (* Cryo Temp Total Sensor Loss Trip *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: ULTRASONIC CAVITATION, THERMAL VITRIFICATION & LASER PSD ANALYSIS
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.1: LANG-RAYLEIGH HIGH-FREQUENCY ULTRASONIC ATOMIZATION PHYSICS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rPiezoFreq_kHz > 50.0 THEN
    (* Capillary wavelength: lambda_cap = ((8.0 * PI * sigma) / (rho * f^2))^(1/3) *)
    rAcousticWaveLength_um := ( (8.0 * rPI * rSurfaceTension_Npm) / 
                               (rLiquidDensity_kgm3 * (rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0) * (rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0)) ) ** (0.333333);
    rAcousticWaveLength_um := rAcousticWaveLength_um * 1000000.0; (* Convert [m] to [um] *)

    (* Lang Droplet Median Diameter Prediction: d_p = 0.340 * lambda_cap *)
    rTheoreticalDropletD50_um := rLangConstant * rAcousticWaveLength_um;

    (* Acoustic Energy Dissipation & Cavitation Inception Number *)
    (* PZT-8 mechanical quality factor Qm approx 600. Effective radiating horn area ~ 2.8e-4 m^2 *)
    rAcousticEnergyDensity_Jm3 := (rPiezoPower_W * 0.72) / (0.00028 * 1480.0); (* E = P_ac / (A * c) *)
    rCavitationIndex := rAcousticEnergyDensity_Jm3 / (101325.0 + 100.0 * rAtomizerChamberPress_mbar);
ELSE
    rTheoreticalDropletD50_um := 20.0;
    rCavitationIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Co-Axial Core-to-Shell Hydrodynamic Coupling and Shell Thickness *)
IF rShellFlowRate_mLmin > 0.001 THEN
    rEffectiveCoreShellRatio := rCoreFlowRate_mLmin / rShellFlowRate_mLmin;
    (* Volumetric core microsphere diameter: d_core = d_p * (R_cs / (1.0 + R_cs))^(1/3) *)
    rCalculatedShellThickness_um := 0.5 * rLaserD50_um * 
        (1.0 - (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio / (1.0 + rEffectiveCoreShellRatio)) ** (0.333333));
ELSE
    rEffectiveCoreShellRatio := 99.0;
    rCalculatedShellThickness_um := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.2: CRYOGENIC THERMAL VITRIFICATION & BOIL-OFF MASS BALANCE
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Total Heat Influx into Nitrogen Bath: Q_total = Q_ambient + Q_spray + Q_piezo_scatter *)
(* Droplet Enthalpy Quench: m_dot_spray * [cp_liq*(T_in - T_f) + L_fusion + cp_ice*(T_f - T_LN2)] *)
(* Average specific heat ~ 3800 J/kg/K, Latent heat ~ 280 kJ/kg, subcooling to 77.4 K *)
rBoilOffMassFlow_kgs := ( rAmbientHeatLeak_W + 
                          ((rCoreFlowRate_mLmin + rShellFlowRate_mLmin) * (1.12 / 60000.0) * 850000.0) +
                          (rPiezoPower_W * 0.18) ) / rLatentHeatVap_Jkg;

rEstimatedBoilOffRate_kgh := rBoilOffMassFlow_kgs * 3600.0;

(* Droplet Vitrification Dynamics & Lumped Biot Number Verification *)
(* h_cryo during micro-acoustic boiling agitation ~ 1450 W/m^2/K, k_droplet ~ 0.56 W/m/K *)
IF rLaserD50_um > 1.0 THEN
    rThermalBiotNumber := (1450.0 * (rLaserD50_um * 0.0000005)) / (3.0 * 0.56);
    (* Vitrification cooling rate: dT/dt = (6.0 * h * Delta_T) / (rho * cp * d_p) *)
    rDropletQuenchRate_Ks := (6.0 * 1450.0 * (293.15 - rVotedTemp_K)) / 
                             (rLiquidDensity_kgm3 * 3800.0 * (rLaserD50_um * 0.000001));
    rDropletFreezingTime_ms := (293.15 - 135.0) / (rDropletQuenchRate_Ks + 0.001) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rThermalBiotNumber := 0.05;
    rDropletQuenchRate_Ks := 2500.0;
    rDropletFreezingTime_ms := 65.0;
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.3: IN-LINE LASER DIFFRACTION PARTICLE SIZE DISTRIBUTION (PSD) ANALYSIS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Polydispersity Span Calculation: Span = (D90 - D10) / D50 *)
IF rLaserD50_um > 0.50 THEN
    rCurrentSpan := (rLaserD90_um - rLaserD10_um) / rLaserD50_um;
ELSE
    rCurrentSpan := 0.80;
END_IF;

(* 1st-Order Exponential Smoothing Filters for Noise Rejection (Tau = 0.25 s) *)
rLaserFilteredD50_um := rLaserFilteredD50_um + 0.1667 * (rLaserD50_um - rLaserFilteredD50_um);
rLaserFilteredSpan   := rLaserFilteredSpan   + 0.1667 * (rCurrentSpan - rLaserFilteredSpan);

(* Optical Obscuration Health & Anti-Frosting Purge Management *)
(* Ideal Obscuration window: 12.0% to 22.0% *)
IF rLaserObscuration_pct < 6.0 THEN
    (* Plume loss or insufficient density *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000100; (* Warning Bit 8: Optical Obscuration Low *)
ELSIF rLaserObscuration_pct > 28.0 THEN
    (* Severe multiple scattering or window cryo-frosting *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000200; (* Warning Bit 9: Optical Obscuration High *)
    bWindowPurgeRequest := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Window Quartz Defrosting Cycle: 1.5s Purge burst every 45 seconds *)
tWindowPurgeCycleTimer(IN := NOT tWindowPurgeCycleTimer.Q, PT := T#45S);
IF tWindowPurgeCycleTimer.Q OR bWindowPurgeRequest THEN
    tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
    bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := TRUE;
    rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 35.0; (* Energize heating blanket *)
    IF tWindowPurgeTimer.Q THEN
        tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := FALSE;
        bWindowPurgeRequest       := FALSE;
        rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 10.0; (* Keep-warm standby *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := FALSE;
    rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) Status Verification *)
bMicrosphereQualityOK := (rLaserFilteredD50_um >= (rTargetD50_um - 2.5)) AND
                         (rLaserFilteredD50_um <= (rTargetD50_um + 2.5)) AND
                         (rLaserFilteredSpan <= rTargetSpan) AND
                         (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio >= (rTargetCoreShellRatio * 0.85)) AND
                         (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio <= (rTargetCoreShellRatio * 1.15)) AND
                         (rVotedTemp_K <= 82.0);

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: 5x5 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & PROJECTED GRADIENT MPC
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Pack Actual Measurements Vector: y[k] = [D50_filtered, Span_filtered, Voted_Bath_Level]^T *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rLaserFilteredD50_um;
vecMeas_y[2] := rLaserFilteredSpan;
vecMeas_y[3] := rVotedLevel_mm;

(* Formulate State Target Vector: x_sp *)
vecTarget_x[1] := rTargetD50_um;
vecTarget_x[2] := rTargetSpan;
vecTarget_x[3] := rTargetBathLevel_mm;
vecTarget_x[4] := 77.36;                   (* Liquid Nitrogen boiling point at ambient pressure [K] *)
vecTarget_x[5] := rTargetTransducerPower_W;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.1: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER MEASUREMENT UPDATE & TIME PROPAGATION
   1. Compute Innovation Residual: e[k] = y[k] - C_d * x_pred[k]
   2. State Measurement Correction: x[k|k] = x_pred[k] + K * e[k]
   3. Time Propagation for Next Cycle: x_pred[k+1] = A_d * x[k|k] + B_d * u[k]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + matC[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x_pred[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecResidual_y[iRow] := vecMeas_y[iRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman State Correction: x = x_pred + K * e *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + matK_Kalman[iRow, iCol] * vecResidual_y[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iRow] := vecState_x_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Measurement Residual Plausibility Check (Innovation Monitoring) *)
IF (ABS(vecResidual_y[1]) > 12.0) OR (ABS(vecResidual_y[2]) > 0.65) THEN
    (* Severe innovation divergence -> Flag Optical Path Anomaly *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000400; (* Warning Bit 10: Kalman Innovation Anomaly *)
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.2: CONSTRAINED MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   Iterative Projected Gradient Descent over Quadratic Cost:
   J = 0.5 * sum( Q_i * (x_i - x_target_i)^2 ) + 0.5 * sum( R_j * (u_j - u_prev_j)^2 )
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoMPC_Mode AND (iMachineState = 70) AND (dwActiveAlarmsWord = 16#00000000) THEN

    (* Initialize Input Candidate from Previous Solution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        
        (* Gradient Calculation: nabla_J_u = B_d^T * Q * (A_d*x + B_d*u - x_sp) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            (* Direct sensitivity approximation for gradient computation *)
            rTempSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
                rTempSum := rTempSum + matB[iRow, iCol] * vecWeight_Q[iRow] * (vecState_x[iRow] - vecTarget_x[iRow]);
            END_FOR;
            (* Add Actuator Slew Rate Regularization *)
            rTempSum := rTempSum + vecWeight_R[iCol] * (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]);
            vecGradient_g[iCol] := rTempSum;
        END_FOR;

        vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u[1] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[1];
        vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u[2] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[2];
        vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u[3] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[3];
        vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u[4] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[4];
        vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u[5] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[5];

        (* u1: Piezo Power [W] *)
        IF vecInput_u[1] < rMinPiezoPower_W THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMinPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[1] > rMaxPiezoPower_W THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMaxPiezoPower_W; END_IF;

        (* u2: Piezo Frequency [kHz] *)
        IF vecInput_u[2] < rMinPiezoFreq_kHz THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMinPiezoFreq_kHz; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[2] > rMaxPiezoFreq_kHz THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMaxPiezoFreq_kHz; END_IF;

        (* u3: Core Pump Delivery [mL/min] *)
        IF vecInput_u[3] < rMinCorePump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMinCorePump_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[3] > rMaxCorePump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMaxCorePump_mLmin; END_IF;

        (* u4: Shell Pump Delivery [mL/min] *)
        IF vecInput_u[4] < rMinShellPump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[4] := rMinShellPump_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[4] > rMaxShellPump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[4] := rMaxShellPump_mLmin; END_IF;

        (* u5: Cryogenic Valve Demand [%] *)
        IF vecInput_u[5] < rMinCryoValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMinCryoValve_pct; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[5] > rMaxCryoValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMaxCryoValve_pct; END_IF;

    END_FOR;

    (* Delta u1: Piezo Power *)
    vecDeltaU[1] := vecInput_u[1] - vecInput_u_prev[1];
    IF vecDeltaU[1] > rMaxDeltaU1_Power THEN vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] + rMaxDeltaU1_Power; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[1] < -rMaxDeltaU1_Power THEN vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] - rMaxDeltaU1_Power; END_IF;

    (* Delta u2: Piezo Frequency *)
    vecDeltaU[2] := vecInput_u[2] - vecInput_u_prev[2];
    IF vecDeltaU[2] > rMaxDeltaU2_Freq THEN vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] + rMaxDeltaU2_Freq; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[2] < -rMaxDeltaU2_Freq THEN vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] - rMaxDeltaU2_Freq; END_IF;

    IF vecDeltaU[3] > rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump THEN vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u_prev[3] + rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[3] < -rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump THEN vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u_prev[3] - rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump; END_IF;

    (* Delta u4: Shell Pump Flow *)
    vecDeltaU[4] := vecInput_u[4] - vecInput_u_prev[4];
    IF vecDeltaU[4] > rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump THEN vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u_prev[4] + rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[4] < -rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump THEN vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u_prev[4] - rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump; END_IF;

    (* Delta u5: Cryo Valve Demand *)
    vecDeltaU[5] := vecInput_u[5] - vecInput_u_prev[5];
    IF vecDeltaU[5] > rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve THEN vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u_prev[5] + rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[5] < -rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve THEN vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u_prev[5] - rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve; END_IF;

    (* Assign Manipulated Actuator Demands *)
    rPiezoPowerSP_W        := vecInput_u[1];
    rPiezoFreqSP_kHz       := vecInput_u[2];
    rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin  := vecInput_u[3];
    rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin := vecInput_u[4];
    rCryoValveDemand_pct   := vecInput_u[5];

ELSE
    (* =============================================================================================
       GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: DECOUPLED GAIN-SCHEDULED PID FALLBACK CONTROLLERS
       Active when bAutoMPC_Mode is FALSE, optical obscuration is degraded, or machine state < 70
       ============================================================================================= *)
    IF (iMachineState = 70) THEN
        (* Raise Warning Bit 11: Degradation Fallback PID Mode Active *)
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000800;

        (* 1. D50 Droplet Size Control Loop -> Modulates Piezo Active Power Setpoint *)
        rPidD50_Error    := rTargetD50_um - rLaserFilteredD50_um;
        rPidD50_Integral := rPidD50_Integral + (rPidD50_Error * rSamplingTime_s);
        (* Anti-windup clamping *)
        IF rPidD50_Integral > 15.0 THEN rPidD50_Integral := 15.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidD50_Integral < -15.0 THEN rPidD50_Integral := -15.0; END_IF;

        rPiezoPowerSP_W := rTargetTransducerPower_W - (rPidD50_Kp * rPidD50_Error) - 
                           ((rPidD50_Kp / rPidD50_Ti) * rPidD50_Integral) - 
                           (rPidD50_Td * (rPidD50_Error - rPidD50_PrevError) / rSamplingTime_s);
        rPidD50_PrevError := rPidD50_Error;

        (* Clamp Piezo Output *)
        IF rPiezoPowerSP_W < rMinPiezoPower_W THEN rPiezoPowerSP_W := rMinPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        IF rPiezoPowerSP_W > rMaxPiezoPower_W THEN rPiezoPowerSP_W := rMaxPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        rPiezoFreqSP_kHz := rOptimalResonanceFreq_kHz;

        rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin  := 0.850;
        rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin := 0.850 / (rTargetCoreShellRatio + 0.001);

        rPidLevel_Error    := rTargetBathLevel_mm - rVotedLevel_mm;
        rPidLevel_Integral := rPidLevel_Integral + (rPidLevel_Error * rSamplingTime_s);
        IF rPidLevel_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidLevel_Integral < -100.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := -100.0; END_IF;

                                (rPidLevel_Td * (rPidLevel_Error - rPidLevel_PrevError) / rSamplingTime_s);
        rPidLevel_PrevError := rPidLevel_Error;

        IF rCryoValveDemand_pct < rMinCryoValve_pct THEN rCryoValveDemand_pct := rMinCryoValve_pct; END_IF;
        IF rCryoValveDemand_pct > rMaxCryoValve_pct THEN rCryoValveDemand_pct := rMaxCryoValve_pct; END_IF;

        vecInput_u[1] := rPiezoPowerSP_W;
        vecInput_u[2] := rPiezoFreqSP_kHz;
        vecInput_u[3] := rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin;
        vecInput_u[4] := rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin;
        vecInput_u[5] := rCryoValveDemand_pct;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
    vecInput_u_prev[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol];
